description.en: Meiolania platyceps: whole living environment prop. Nominal 1m whole-length artistic setting. Australian Museum 1974 Alex Ritchie composite p48, not a single complete skeleton or specimen. Low broad shell, large horned head, four short land legs and long spiked ring armor tail. Tail terminal conservatively tapered; no ankylosaur bulb. Color, scute facets, soft tissue, digit and ring counts artistic.
description.zh: Meiolania风格化完整活体环境道具；软组织、姿态、颜色与名义尺度含艺术解释，并非精确标本。

scientific_scope.intentional_overlap: Closed shell and plastron overlap internally; short neck, four limb roots and tail root overlap at anatomical joints. Closed components not watertight union. Four limbs only.
